claims: Olivier Rioux weighs approximately 305 lbs (138 kg).
Olivier Rioux plays for the Florida Gators men's basketball team.
Olivier Rioux is officially recognized as the world's tallest teenager by the Guinness World Records.
Olivier Rioux is recognized as the tallest player in college basketball history.
Olivier Rioux is joining the Gators for the 2024-25 season.
Olivier Rioux was born on February 2, 2006, in Terrebonne, Quebec.
Olivier Rioux was 6'1" tall at age eight.
Olivier Rioux was over 7' tall before entering seventh grade.
Olivier Rioux played for Canada's national team in several FIBA events.
Canada's national team won a bronze medal at the 2023 U18 FIBA AmeriCup.
Olivier Rioux's older brother is 6'9" tall.
